title: ctenitopsis dissecta
intro: Ctenitopsis dissecta, commonly known as Ctenitis dissecta, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, acting as an antioxidant, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Ctenitis dissecta include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Ctenitis dissecta include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
